workouts.dayLabel: Tuesday - Lower A — Quad Focus + Delts

exercises.reason: Latest 280 for 4 × 10 RIR 3/3/2/2 versus earlier 300 × 10 RIR 4–5. This supports a small next-step trial on the same machine, not a mandatory two-session hold. 280 remains baseline until increment is confirmed; start 6–8 after adding weight.

Latest 185/185/205 × 10 RIR 4/4/2 demonstrates 205 successfully; mixed ramping does not justify returning automatically to 185. Trial 205 for 6–8 across working sets, at RIR 2. Return 185 if the minimum or form cannot be repeated.

Latest 140 × 14/15/15 RIR 1/2/1, after 140 × 12 RIR 1. Keep 140 but start 10–12 and stop at prescribed RIR rather than forcing 15. If 10 is already too hard, use a lower recorded setting; no increase now.

Latest 165 × 15 RIR 4 then 175 × 15/15 RIR 1/1. 175 merits a lower-rep trial at 12–13 to restore RIR 2, not automatic rejection because 15 was hard. Return 165 if 10–12 cannot be achieved at target effort.
Latest 25 per hand 3 × 20 RIR 3/2/1; earlier sessions also showed late failure. Keep 25 but use 18–19 rather than forcing 20. No increase until all sets stay at prescribed effort.

User confirmed the same machine. Latest 70 for 3 × 20 RIR 2/2/1 establishes 70; use 17–19 at RIR 2 rather than automatically dropping to 60. Earlier mixed 60/70/90 is context, not a reason to select the minimum.
Latest Oct 30 10 min at 2.7 mph/11%; Oct 28 30 min at the same pace/incline. Preserve each program duration and conversational effort. No resistance load and no invented pace/incline increase.

Keep bodyweight only. October 31 completed 15/15 at RIR 2/2, improving on October 23 ending at RIR 1; October 28 had a third set of 14 at RIR 1. For the three-set day start at 13–14; for the two-set day aim for 15 at RIR 2–3. No external load.

Latest 40 × 15 RIR 2 then 45 × 15 RIR 5 supports 45 as the next working baseline, not 40. Start 12–15 on that same cable. Final RIR 5 warrants evaluating the next available step; its size is not yet confirmed.

Latest 130/140/145 × 12 RIR 4/3/2 versus prior 115/130/130 × 12 establishes 145. Trial 145 for 10–12 at RIR 2 across working sets rather than resetting 130; return 140 if minimum 8 or effort cannot be repeated.

November 2 recorded 75 per hand for 4 x 10 at RIR 3/4/2/3, versus October 29 11/11/10 at RIR 1/1/0 and October 26 70 x 10 ending RIR 1. Build toward 11–12 at 75, stopping at prescribed RIR 2. Final RIR 3 supports progression, but confirm the stale '70 lb per hand' note versus actual 75 and the available dumbbell step before adding load.

Latest 45/55/60 × 15 RIR 4/3/2 versus prior 40/45/50 supports 60 as a working trial. Start 12–15 at RIR 2 on that cable; use 55 if 10–12 cannot be repeated. Ramping alone is not an inconsistency penalty.
Latest 15 for 4 × 20 ended RIR 1; prior 20/20/20/18 also ended RIR 1. Keep 15 and target 17–19 so effort stays at RIR 2; no heavier trial while final sets exceed prescribed effort.

User confirmed the same machine. Latest 70 for 3 × 20 RIR 2/2/1 establishes 70; use 17–19 at RIR 2 rather than automatically dropping to 60. Earlier mixed 60/70/90 is context, not a reason to select the minimum.

Use the user-confirmed 90 lb machine setting. October 31 reached 15/14/12 at RIR 2/1/0, following 15/15/12 ending at RIR 0 on October 29. Hold 90 and start at 10 reps, stopping at RIR 2–3 on every set. If 10 cannot meet that effort, use the previously demonstrated 80 lb setting; repeated failure does not support an increase.

Latest 60 × 15 then 65 × 15/12 RIR 4/2/0 demonstrates 65 before fatigue. Trial 65 for 10 at RIR 2 instead of forcing 15 or reverting 55. Return 60 if 10 already requires RIR 0–1; rope setup must match.

workouts.dayLabel: Friday - Lower B — Posterior Chain + Delts

exercises.reason: Latest 180 for 3 × 15 RIR 3/3/2 after 3 × 10 supports a small next-step trial; no second-session gate. 180 remains established baseline until machine increment is confirmed; start 10–12 after adding the smallest available step.

Latest 200 for 2 × 15 RIR 2/2 after 2 × 12 supports a small next-step trial now. 200 remains baseline until the available increment is confirmed; start 12 after that step. No additional qualifying session is required by itself.

Latest 140 × 14/15/15 RIR 1/2/1, after 140 × 12 RIR 1. Keep 140 but start 10–12 and stop at prescribed RIR rather than forcing 15. If 10 is already too hard, use a lower recorded setting; no increase now.

Latest 25/45/45 × 15 RIR 4/4/2 demonstrates 45 across two working sets. Use 45 for 12–15 at target effort, not 25 because of the lighter opening set. Return 25 only if minimum 10 or controlled form cannot be repeated.

Latest 300 × 20/20/19 RIR 4/3/0 versus earlier 3 × 12 RIR 2. Keep 300 for 16–17 at RIR 2, not forced 20 to failure. If minimum 12 is still too hard use a lower demonstrated load; no heavier trial now.
Latest 25 per hand 3 × 20 RIR 3/2/1; earlier sessions also showed late failure. Keep 25 but use 18–19 rather than forcing 20. No increase until all sets stay at prescribed effort.
Latest Oct 30 10 min at 2.7 mph/11%; Oct 28 30 min at the same pace/incline. Preserve each program duration and conversational effort. No resistance load and no invented pace/incline increase.

Hold 85 lb per hand. October 31 improved to 12/10/8/8 reps versus four sets of 8 on October 23, but the final set reached RIR 1. Start with 8–10 reps and stop at RIR 2–3; avoid spending all reserve on the first set. No load increase yet.

Adopt the demonstrated 80 lb working load: October 31 was 15/15 reps at RIR 2/1, up from 60/70 lb × 12 at RIR 4 on October 23. Aim for 12–14 reps at RIR 2–3 rather than forcing 15. No further load increase while the final set is below the effort target.

Conditional 200 lb trial if that setting is available on the same machine. October 31: 190 lb × 15/15 at RIR 3/4, versus 190 × 12 at RIR 2 on October 23. Both sets reached the rep ceiling with reserve, supporting a small increase now. Start at 12 reps; use 190 if the setting is unavailable or 12 reps cannot stay at RIR 2–3. The machine increment remains unconfirmed.

Hold 70 lb and start at 10 reps. October 31 improved to 12/12/11 at RIR 3/2/1; October 23 included failed 80 lb sets at 8/7 reps and RIR 1. Build repeatable reps at RIR 2–3 before another heavier trial; do not force the last set to 12.

Hold 30 for 12–14 at RIR 2. November 2 two sets of 15 ended RIR 2, improving on October 26 RIR 1, but October 31 three sets of 15 ended RIR 1. This three-set day retains fewer reps to manage late fatigue. Older 40 x 10 succeeded on October 23; do not jump 33% without matching setup and repeatable effort. The two-set day can assess a smaller available step.

Use the user-confirmed 90 lb machine setting. October 31 reached 15/14/12 at RIR 2/1/0, following 15/15/12 ending at RIR 0 on October 29. Hold 90 and start at 10 reps, stopping at RIR 2–3 on every set. If 10 cannot meet that effort, use the previously demonstrated 80 lb setting; repeated failure does not support an increase.

Hold the successful 25 lb load and start at 10–12 reps at RIR 2–3. October 31: 25 × 10, 20 × 15, then 25 × 14, all RIR 2, improving on three 25 lb sets ending at RIR 0 on October 23. The heavier final set succeeded; do not default to the 20 lb middle set. Use 20 if fatigue prevents the minimum 10 at target effort.

Hold 30 lb for 12–13 reps at RIR 2–3. October 31 improved to 15/14 at RIR 3/1 from 30 × 10 followed by a failed 35 × 10 at RIR 0 on October 23. Reduce forced reps on the second set before another load increase.

Hold 70 lb and start at 12 reps at RIR 2–3. October 31 improved to 15/14 at RIR 2/1 from 12/11 at RIR 2/0 on October 23. Both sets now meet the minimum, so reassess fewer reps at 70 rather than automatically lowering the load; use a lower available setting if 12 cannot meet effort.

Keep bodyweight only. October 31 completed 15/15 at RIR 2/2, improving on October 23 ending at RIR 1; October 28 had a third set of 14 at RIR 1. For the three-set day start at 13–14; for the two-set day aim for 15 at RIR 2–3. No external load.

November 2 improved 255 from 5/5/5/4 to 5/5/5/5, final RIR 2; third set still RIR 1. Earlier October 15 fell from 6 to 4 reps. Hold 255, aim 5 but stop at 4 when needed for RIR 2; build repeatable 5–6 before heavier load.

Adopt recorded 75 per hand: November 2 four sets of 10 at RIR 3/4/2/3, improved from October 29 11/11/10 ending RIR 0 and October 26 70 x 10 ending RIR 1. At the 10-rep ceiling, a smallest available dumbbell step merits review. First confirm actual 75 versus stale '70 lb per hand' note and available step; retain 75 meanwhile, stop at RIR 2. Do not infer a heavier setting.

Initialize from demonstrated 180: November 2 12/12/12 at RIR 3/3/2, improved from October 26 ending RIR 1; October 15 ramped successfully to 180. Ceiling reached with reserve supports a conditional smallest available same-machine step, starting 8–10 reps at RIR 2. Confirm the available increment; retain 180 x 12 until known.

November 2 160 x 12/12/12 at RIR 3/2/1 improves on October 26 12/12/10 but repeats October 15 late RIR 1. Hold 160, begin 10–11 and stop at RIR 2 rather than forcing 12; no increase while late-set effort remains too high.

Initialize at successful 15: November 2 18/19/19 at RIR 2/2/1 improves on October 26 ramp from 10 to 15 x 18 at RIR 0. Retain 15 with 17–18 reps at RIR 2; fewer reps within range should preserve effort. Do not revert automatically to the earlier 10 or increase load now.

November 2 70 x 12/11 at RIR 4/1; October 26 heavier 80 x 8 reached RIR 0, and October 15 70 x 12 ended RIR 0. Hold 70 total for 10–11 at RIR 2, preserving reserve on the first set. Failed 80 is not a working baseline; no heavier trial now.

Initialize at 30: November 2 two sets of 15 at RIR 3/2 improved on October 26 ending RIR 1. October 31 three sets ended RIR 1, so keep the three-set day's lower rep target. For this two-set day, ceiling at RIR 2 supports a conditional smallest available cable step at 10–12 reps; confirm increment first, otherwise hold 30 x 15. Older 40 x 10 is context, not an automatic 33% jump.

Initialize at demonstrated 70: November 2 3 x 15 at RIR 2/2/2, following October 26 3 x 15 at RIR 3/3/2 and October 15 successful 70 sets. Rep ceiling supports a conditional smallest available cable step, starting 10–12 at RIR 2. What step is available? Retain 70 x 15 until confirmed; no invented machine setting.
